name: TMK Chemical Bhd
overview: TMK Chemical 今年主要推进以 RM939.9 million 收购 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 100% 股权的交易，并已签署有条件买卖协议；同时其子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 完成一项物业收购。此外，集团与关联方的经常性关联交易实际金额超出此前披露的预估上限。
overview_en: TMK Chemical's main corporate action this year is the proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) for RM939.9 million, with a conditional share sale and purchase agreement signed; its subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd also completed a property acquisition. In addition, actual recurrent related party transaction values exceeded previously disclosed estimated limits.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 推进收购 CCM 全部股权，并处理关联交易实际金额超出预估上限的事宜。
segments.note_en: Progressing the acquisition of 100% of CCM and addressing recurrent related party transactions exceeding estimated limits.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就 CCM 收购事项向 Bursa Securities 申请延长提交额外上市申请及股东通函草案的期限。
actions.text_en: Submitted an application to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to submit the additional listing application and draft circular to shareholders in relation to the CCM acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告 TMK Group 与 KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Announced that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions between TMK Group and KLK Bioenergy Sdn Bhd exceeded the estimated limit by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Batu Kawan Berhad 及 Enternal Edge Sdn Bhd 签署有条件股权买卖协议，以 RM939.9 million 收购 CCM 100% 股权，代价以约 RM438.5 million 现金及按每股 RM1.9098 发行 262,500,000 股新股支付。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale and purchase agreement with Batu Kawan Berhad and Enternal Edge Sdn Bhd to acquire 100% equity interest in CCM for RM939.9 million, satisfied via approximately RM438.5 million cash and the issuance of 262,500,000 new share…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Batu Kawan Berhad 再次同意将 CCM 收购事项的独家谈判期延长至 2026 年 9 月 12 日。
actions.text_en: Agreed with Batu Kawan Berhad to further extend the exclusivity period for the CCM acquisition to 12 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Batu Kawan Berhad 同意将 CCM 收购事项的独家谈判期延长一个月至 2026 年 9 月 12 日。
actions.text_en: Agreed with Batu Kawan Berhad to extend the exclusivity period for the CCM acquisition by one month to 12 September 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 发出不具约束力的意向书，拟以 RM920.0 million 收购 Batu Kawan Berhad 全资子公司 Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM) 的 100% 股权，并已获对方原则性接受。
actions.text_en: Issued a non-binding letter of intent to acquire 100% equity interest in Chemical Company of Malaysia Berhad (CCM), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Batu Kawan Berhad, at an indicative purchase consideration of RM920.0 million, with acceptance-in-principle receive…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告 TMK Group 与 Taiko Bleaching Earth Sdn Bhd 及 Taiko Acid Works Sdn Bhd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Announced that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions between TMK Group and Taiko Bleaching Earth Sdn Bhd and Taiko Acid Works Sdn Bhd exceeded the estimated limit by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告 TMK Group 与 RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd 的经常性关联交易实际金额进一步超出预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Announced that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions between TMK Group and RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd further exceeded the estimated limit by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告 TMK Group 与 RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出此前披露的预估上限 10% 以上。
actions.text_en: Announced that the actual value of recurrent related party transactions between TMK Group and RCL Industrial Products Pte Ltd exceeded the previously disclosed estimated limit by more than 10%.

segments.name: 氯碱衍生物制造
segments.note: 子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 完成一项物业收购。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd completed a property acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd 完成此前公布的物业收购。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Chlor-Al Chemical Pte Ltd completed the previously announced proposed acquisition of property.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟通过收购 CCM 100% 股权，将 CCM 集团纳入 TMK，交易对价 RM939.9 million，其中部分以发行新股支付。
model_changes.text_en: Proposes to bring the CCM group into TMK via the acquisition of 100% equity interest in CCM for a total consideration of RM939.9 million, partly satisfied by the issuance of new shares.
